selected_evidence.summary: Showed /tmp not separately mounted, /dev/shm lacking noexec, current fstab, and initial boot_id dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e

selected_evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm configured with noexec,nosuid,nodev and persisted in fstab
selected_evidence.summary: fstab updated with tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm using nosuid,nodev,noexec; findmnt confirms options applied; exec attempts on both paths returned Permission denied (rc=126)

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline of the specific hardening (immediately before reboot)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed boot_id dfdea52d..., /tmp and /dev/shm mount options, and fstab entries right before initiating restart
Backgrounded shutdown -r now command; exec call returned success acknowledging dispatch before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node down / connection dropped due to restart
selected_evidence.summary: Connection reset by peer confirms node was mid-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: New boot_id 573fdad6-9552-4bdc-ab02-5f6be39b23a5 differs from pre-restart dfdea52d..., proving the kernel actually restarted

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required mount hardening, functionally verified
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, /tmp and /dev/shm both show nosuid,nodev,noexec (mounted automatically from fstab), exec attempts denied (rc=126 both), and fstab entries intact

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: backup fstab"
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: add /tmp entry to fstab if missing"
if ! grep -qE '^\S+\s+/tmp\s' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
fi

echo "STEP: update /dev/shm entry in fstab"
if grep -qE '^\S+\s+/dev/shm\s' /etc/fstab; then
  sudo -n sed -i -E 's#^(\S+\s+/dev/shm\s+\S+\s+)\S+(\s+.*)#\1defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec\2#' /etc/fstab
else
  echo "tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
fi

echo "STEP: reload systemd units from fstab"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload

echo "STEP: mount /tmp fresh per fstab"
sudo -n mount /tmp

echo "STEP: remount /dev/shm with new options"
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "== fstab after =="
cat /etc/fstab

echo "== verify /tmp =="
findmnt /tmp

echo "== verify /dev/shm =="
findmnt /dev/shm

echo "STEP: functional check - exec should be blocked on /tmp"
cat > /tmp/hello.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo hello-from-tmp
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/hello.sh
set +e
/tmp/hello.sh
rc=$?
set -e
echo "exec_rc=$rc (expect nonzero, permission denied due to noexec)"

echo "STEP: functional check - exec should be blocked on /dev/shm"
cat > /dev/shm/hello.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo hello-from-shm
EOF
chmod +x /dev/shm/hello.sh
set +e
/dev/shm/hello.sh
rc2=$?
set -e
echo "exec_rc2=$rc2 (expect nonzero, permission denied due to noexec)"
